response.original_b10:
Our Firm’s tax practice is well known for its expertise on a broad range of tax issues including consulting and general advising on tax matters and the interrelations with corporate, regulatory, labor and finance issues.
Our team has the capability to face any complexities and work with the clients, managing the important changes and challenges that Venezuela imposes due to the political and economic environment.

Over the last year, our practice has encompassed tax planning of several Venezuelan and multinational entities, legal advice to individuals, inheritance, and wealth planning; as well as related tax disputes (administrative and judicial procedures against Tax authorities and Courts).

Moreover, our practice is recognized for providing timely and accurate assistance to clients in all tax matters involving their operations, including tax assistance in restructuring and reorganization projects. Our key clients include entities of the following economic sectors: oil and gas sector, banking and financial institutions, private medical services, construction, IT and software development, food and beverages production, information product and services, such as: Summus, Gruppo Montenegro; Editores Orientales, C.A (EOCA); Grupo BDO, SKU Logistics Corp, Microsoft Venezuela; PepsiCo Alimentos; Universal Music Venezuela; Grupo Pizzolante; Centro Médico de Caracas; Branza 1800, S.A.; Mapfre; Grupo Ceballos; Sucesión Zuloaga; Inversiones AEFEVE;.; Tecnipisicinas, S.A.; Grupo Otaola; Distribuidora Bolivar Films, Kyndryl de Venezuela, Industrias Venezolana de Limpieza, (VENELIN), Programa Mundial de Alimentos (UN).

We stand out among our peers for innovating in the sector and for our ability to adapt to change. The perfect example for that is ARAQUEREYNA WithU ( HYPERLINK "https://mailchi.mp/acc861a2cc48/emprendedores" https://mailchi.mp/acc861a2cc48/emprendedores), a project that offers legal kits, and preferential rates, to entrepreneurs; the purpose is that entrepreneurs have access to legal assistance for their new businesses in one of the most important law firms in Venezuela.

Developing a strong network of contacts within the most important practice related organizations and events in the tax field is one of our strong points. We act as an active member of international and local legal organizations, such as IFA, IBA, ABA, AVDT, Latin American Tax Association, VENAMCHAM, CAVECOL and BRITCHAM.

Thanks to our reputation on all Tax Law matters in the country, the firm has represented Venezuela in international tax events and forums during the last ten years, interacting with lawyers from different jurisdictions including USA, Asia, Europe, and Latin America, allowing the Firm to approach the tax practice area in a local and global way.

Over the past three years, we have worked hard to strengthen our department, bringing in both national and international cases of great scope, relevance and complexity. We believe that these achievements justify a better position for the department in the rankings. In particular, we believe that Ms María Carolina Cano deserves to be recognised in Band 1, Ms. Ingrid Pacheco should be listed at least in Band 2 and Ms María Alejandra García should be highlighted as an associate to watch.

Through a joint work, coordinated by Andrea Di Dio, of DLA Piper Italy, ARAQUEREYNA's Tax and Corporate Departments advised Gruppo Montenegro (a leading Italian Food and Spirits manufacturer) on all the legal aspects related to the acquisition of the Venezuelan rum brand Pampero from Diageo and on the operation, production, commercialization, and distribution of such brand in Venezuela, which enjoys the attributes and protection of the Denomination of Controlled Origin “Ron de Venezuela.”
Analysis and identification of the taxation applicable to the transactions carried out, from the tax perspective, including direct and indirect taxation (IT, VAT), Alcohol and Spirits Tax Act, Customs Regimes and Municipal Taxation.

matters.rawNotes:
ARAQUEREYNA’s Tax Department advises PEPSICO Group (a multinational Food and Beverage American company) on the analysis of all national and municipal tax obligations including the analysis and appeal of tax objections regarding national and local (municipal) taxes.
During 2024, we assisted our client in tax audits procedures carried out by the Venezuelan Tax Authority (SENIAT) regarding Income Tax and Value Added Tax regulations from fiscal years 2019 and 2020, specifically related to the tax effects of foreign exchange gains and losses, in view of the hyperinflation and currency devaluation processes occurring in the country.
Our team also assists in the identification and managing of transfer pricing implications involving other related entities of PEPSICO GROUP abroad and provide on-going advice on new tax regulations.

ARAQUEREYNA's Tax and Corporate and M&A Department provides legal counsel to BDO Colombia (a BDO Group member) as they establish operations in Venezuela. We assist in structuring, organizing, and designing the optimal legal entities for their local activities. Our team tailored solutions to BDO Colombia's specific business needs, drafts necessary legal documents, and guides the incorporation process within the Venezuelan legal framework.
ARAQUEREYNA’s Tax team has advised on fiscal management of the two entities through which the BDO group is operating in Venezuela, identifying the most important fiscal and parafiscal obligations. Continuous provision of up-to-date tax services.
More recently we are designing the basis to act under a non-exclusive joint venture scheme to provide legal and tax services, in favor of clients in Venezuela, mainly new businesses or investors coming from Colombia.
